summary: L01 Pasca-P05 retest: (1) Client Dataset Import (LN-011), (2) merging grade-hidden variant twins for Sales, (3) Makloon shrinkage & claim recap. Backend: the 4 requested files passed, 39/39 (dataset_recap 5, sku_mask_settle_tol 12, material_loss 8, grade_visibility 14). I added a new file, test_l01_dataset_edge.py, run against the public URL: 6/8 passed, 2 real bugs found. Frontend admin: the dataset import screen works end to end (template download, dry-run report/summary/unknown values/row status/filters, commit, history shows Diterapkan, rollback restores the DB). The recap screen works (5 KPIs, partner table, 17 detail rows, partner/date filters, reload, empty state). Sales desktop + mobile: twins merge correctly (HIKARI shows 5 variants/5 color chips instead of 11; color 1 stock combined to 10,633.31 kg = sum of 4 SKUs; admin still sees 11 variants with Grade + lot axes). The cart split DOES NOT run in the default setup: with allocation.roll_pick_sales=true (the default), 'Tambah ke Keranjang' opens RollReconcileSheet for the representative SKU only, and the line goes into the cart in purchase_mode 'roll', which skips the split. Result: 'HIKARI 1 — 0 roll (0 kg)' at Rp 0, a single line. After temporarily switching roll_pick_sales=false, the split worked on desktop and mobile (4000 kg -> 2930.32 kg @40,000 + 1069.68 kg @44,000) and the checkout review showed 2 correct lines. SO submission could not be completed because both of sales.kanda's demo customers are credit-blocked for these amounts (not related to this feature). The setting was reset to its default (true).

critical.issue: Re-importing a supplier mapping after a rollback has no effect: rollback sets the new supplier_items record to status=inactive, and the next commit's find_one({product_id, supplier_id}) (client_dataset_service.commit line ~188) finds that inactive record and only $sets the fields WITHOUT reactivating status. The mapping stays inactive/invisible. Reproduced via pytest and in the UI (si_a3921cac5fcf stays inactive after a UI commit).

minor.issue: Manager and MD get 403, but hubTabs.js shows the 'Impor Dataset Client' tab to roles admin/manager/md. Either give them the product.import permission or remove the roles from the tab.
Finance gets 403 (requires record_loss/approve_loss/claim_approve/gl.view), but hubTabs.js shows the 'Rekap Susut & Klaim Mitra' tab to finance. Mismatch between UI and API.

There is no ordering check. Rolling back an OLDER batch after a newer batch touched the same field restores a stale value. Real example found: 2 committed batches were left behind (cdi_40d3f213dafc, cdi_4cfe8337ac63) with customer_color 'TEST_L01 Hitam' on KNKNT0005-I-10XX-XA-XX-XX; T1 rolled both back newest-first. Suggestion: refuse rollback when a newer committed batch touched the same docs, or roll back in LIFO order.

If an exception happens mid-commit, the batch stays 'committing' forever with no 'before' snapshot, so it cannot be rolled back or retried. Store the before-values incrementally or wrap in try/except and set status=failed.

ui_bugs.issue: Default flow (roll_pick_sales=true and rollCount>0) always opens RollReconcileSheet with productId=selected.id (the top-stock member only), then calls onAdd with purchase_mode:'roll'. addToCart skips the split for purchase_mode==='roll' and falls back to members[0]. So the merged card never splits into the real SKUs. In this env (Kanda has no local rolls, stock is group-level) the result is a 0 kg / Rp 0 cart line. Fix: for merged products, skip the reconcile and split by qty, or reconcile per member and merge the roll lines per SKU.

The merged card uses sorted[0].price (the top-stock member). The quickview subtotal shows Rp 160,000,000 for 4000 kg, but the split cart gives Rp 164,278,720 because members have different prices (40k/44k). The sales card range 'Rp 40.000 – Rp 43.000' also hides the 45,000 member (the admin view shows up to 45,000). groupByTemplate should use the price_min/price_max of merged_members, and the quickview subtotal should be computed from the split plan.
When total_available=0, the only option 'Ambil semua + backorder' can still be confirmed and adds a 0 kg / Rp 0 cart line ('HIKARI 1 — 0 roll (0 kg) masuk keranjang').

issues: The partner <select> (class 'field') stretches full width on its own row and 'Muat ulang' wraps to a third line; it should be inline with the date fields (give it w-auto)
The partner dropdown options come from the filtered data: after choosing a partner or a date range with no data, the other partners disappear from the list
The header text '1 produk · 11 SKU' still shows the raw SKU count while the card shows '5 varian' (hidden grade twins are visible through the count)
Mobile cart tab badge shows '99+' for 2 lines (it looks like it sums qty)
After commit, the report rows still say 'Akan diubah' (future tense); consider 'Diubah'

action_items: HIGH: Make the merged-twin cart split work in the default roll-pick flow (ProductQuickView & MobileQuickView: bypass RollReconcileSheet for merged_members, or reconcile per member) and do not add 0-qty roll lines
HIGH: client_dataset_service.commit: when updating an existing supplier_items record, also $set status='active' (and record prev status in 'before' so rollback can restore it)
MEDIUM: Merged price: card range and quickview subtotal must reflect member prices (use price_min/price_max of merged_members, compute subtotal from the split)
MINOR: Align hubTabs roles with API permissions (client-dataset-import: manager/md get 403; makloon-claim-recap: finance gets 403)
MINOR: Guard rollback ordering (LIFO) and recover from stuck 'committing' batches
MINOR: Recap header layout (partner select full width)
critical_code_review_comments: useAppActions.addToCart split: each recursive call adds min(left, member.available_qty) on top of qty already in the cart for that SKU, so adding twice can exceed a member's stock. It also compares qty in the selected unit against available_qty in base_unit (wrong when unit != base_unit, e.g. roll/yard)

mergeHiddenTwins key includes product name; twins whose names differ only by a grade suffix would not merge. It also skips merging whenever p.grade/p.origin is present, so it relies entirely on the server masking
client_dataset_service.get_batch re-runs dry_run on every open (it loads all products/templates, up to 50k docs) - acceptable but heavy
makloon_recap_service loads up to 5000 orders with full steps; consider projection/aggregation as data grows

rca of the issue: Cart split bypass: ProductQuickView line 276 `if (rollCount > 0 && allowRollPick) setShowReconcile(true)` -> RollReconcileSheet(productId=selected.id) -> onConfirm -> onAdd(selected, totalQty, unit, {purchase_mode:'roll'}) -> addToCart line 229 explicitly excludes purchase_mode==='roll' from the split, then line 238 sets product=members[0]. Same in MobileQuickView lines 135/172. Supplier mapping reactivation: commit() finds the existing supplier_items record regardless of status and $sets only the mapping fields; rollback() had set status='inactive' for created records, so the re-imported mapping stays inactive.
